text:
ops-bot: ALERT: multiple nodes in us-west-2 reporting eth0 RX/TX errors and intermittent pod-to-pod drops (c8gn fleet). Seen ~30 alerts in last 10m.

maria: noticed training jobs hitting OOM-ish failures but actually network stalls. pod logs show stalled gradients, kernel dmesg on host shows repeated RX errors.

jamal: which NIC driver? any firmware messages?

maria: these are c8gn with SR-IOV VFs, driver shows 'qede' (Broadcom) on some hosts, 'mlx5' on others (weird mix). dmesg snippet below from one affected host:
```
[Mar 18 12:22:07] qede 0000:3b:00.0: eth0: RX CRC errors: 12345, RX dropped: 6789
[Mar 18 12:22:08] qede 0000:3b:00.0: eth0: link is up, speed 10000Mb/s, full duplex
[Mar 18 12:22:09] qede 0000:3b:00.0: vf 2: LRO GRO failure, resetting queue
[Mar 18 12:22:15] kernel: net_device: eth0: hardware error, resetting
```

ryan: interesting — we also see ICMP 'fragmentation needed' in tcpdump for jumbo frames between hosts. Could be MTU/path mismatch or offload bug. What's host MTU vs VF MTU?

maria: host ifcfg shows MTU=9000 but VFs are inheriting 1500 in some cases. ip link shows VF0 mtu 1500 while parent is 9000 on affected nodes.

jamal: that explains silent drops at large packet sizes. But why RX CRCs? Could be driver incorrectly handling checksum offloads when MTU mismatch or when GRO/LRO aggregated packets cross VF boundary. Try disabling offloads on a test node:
```bash
sudo ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off
sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1500   # test
```

maria: applied on node c8gn-12. Re-ran iperf with 9k vs 1.5k. With offloads off and MTU forced to 1500, loss dropped from ~7% to <0.2%.

sasha: so immediate mitigation is to toggle ethtool offload flags and/or enforce consistent MTU on VFs. Longer term we need vendor firmware/driver fix. Have we raised with partner support?

maria: opened ticket with Broadcom and sent logs + ethtool -k / ethtool -S / dmesg. Ticket ID: BR-2026-032. They asked for firmware version and kernel module version; looks like affected hosts are running qede 1.4.2 and firmware 5.11.x. Some hosts auto-upgraded kernel last week.

eng-oncall: action items:
- jamal: roll a temp cluster-wide config to disable GRO/LRO/GSO/TCO for c8gn AMI image (can be a systemd unit) — start canary on 5 hosts (owner: jamal, ETA 1h).
- ryan: run fleet query to find hosts with mismatched VF MTU vs parent and set tags (owner: ryan, ETA 30m).
- maria: continue vendor ticket and push firmware dump + reproducer steps (owner: maria, ETA EOD).
- sasha: coordinate release note + postmortem template once root cause confirmed (owner: sasha).

jamal: I'll push a DaemonSet that runs ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off in a reconciler loop for the canary. We'll add a kill-switch.

ryan: found 42 hosts in us-west-2 where VF MTU != parent MTU (query: ip -d link show | grep vf | awk...). Tagging them and scheduling immediate grace window for daemonset.

maria: logging more dmesg + tcpdump on reproducer node and attaching to vendor ticket. For now traffic is stable on canary nodes.

sasha: good. If offload toggle continues to mitigate we should bake this into our c8gn AMI until firmware/driver fix. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
